title: 🧠 Ishaan trusted a fluent AI answer... the invented number inside it #ai #aiexplained
title_alts: 🧠 Ishaan learns what AI actually computes... one next word at a time #ai #aiexplained
🧠 Ishaan nearly quoted an AI number... the sixty second check first #ai #aiexplained
description_hook: Every word an AI writes is a fresh guess about what comes next. That one fact explains the fluency and the invented numbers together.
problem_domain: how a language model builds an answer, and the one slot where it invents
setting: a home study desk of printed pages, a phone and a pencilled notepad

characters.name: Ishaan
characters.description: 31, short black hair, grey collared shirt, keeps a folded index card of questions in his shirt pocket

scenes.narration: AI does not know your answer. It guesses the next small piece of text.
scenes.caption: एआई को जवाब पता नहीं होता। वह अगले छोटे टुकड़े का अंदाज़ा लगाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wide sheet of printed text on a dark desk, the final word missing and replaced by an empty pencil-ruled box, dim overhead light, quiet tension.

scenes.narration: Then it guesses again. Then again. It stops when the answer looks finished. Nothing else.
scenes.caption: फिर दूसरा अंदाज़ा, फिर तीसरा। जवाब पूरा लगने तक यही चलता रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: Five paper slips arranged left to right on grey slate, each one carrying a word more than the slip before it, so a sentence assembles across the row, low raking light.

scenes.narration: No plan sits behind that. No finished answer waits in a drawer to be fetched.
scenes.caption: पीछे कोई योजना नहीं। कोई तैयार जवाब कहीं रखा हुआ भी नहीं मिलता।
scenes.image_brief: An empty card index drawer pulled wide open on a library table, every slot inside bare, a brass label holder holding a blank card, cool window light.

scenes.narration: There is only a ranked shortlist of candidates, and a pick from near the top.
scenes.caption: होती है सिर्फ़ संभावित शब्दों की सूची, और उसमें से ऊपर वाला चुनाव।
scenes.image_brief: A chalkboard with five short words stacked in a column, a horizontal bar drawn beside each word shrinking downward, the longest bar at the top, warm lamplight from the right.

scenes.narration: That single trick writes essays. It writes working code. It writes apology letters too.
scenes.caption: इसी एक तरकीब से निबंध बनते हैं, कोड बनता है, माफ़ी की चिट्ठी भी।
scenes.image_brief: Three finished pages fanned across a wooden desk: an essay, a page of code, and a short formal letter, all set in the same typeface, even daylight from above.

scenes.narration: The same trick also invents facts. Smoothly. Confidently. And with no warning bell attached.
scenes.caption: यही तरकीब झूठे तथ्य भी गढ़ देती है, पूरे भरोसे के साथ।
scenes.image_brief: A printed paragraph filling the frame with a single figure ringed in red ink and a question mark inked in the wide margin beside it, hard desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: You already use this every week. Search summaries. Autocorrect. Chat assistants. Support replies. Draft emails.
scenes.caption: आप इसे हर हफ़्ते इस्तेमाल करते हैं: सारांश, ऑटोकरेक्ट, चैट, जवाबी ईमेल।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying face up on a kitchen table showing a message box with a suggested completion in grey text above the keyboard, morning light across the table surface.

scenes.narration: It reads like someone who checked their facts first. That feeling is manufactured. Entirely.
scenes.caption: पढ़ने में लगता है किसी ने जाँच की है। वह भरोसा बनावटी है।
scenes.image_brief: A tidy typed report on a desk beside a rubber approval stamp lying on its side, the ink pad closed and dry, no mark on the paper, flat office light.

scenes.narration: Fluency is exactly what the training rewarded. Truth was never measured directly. Not once.
scenes.caption: प्रशिक्षण ने बहाव को इनाम दिया। सच को कभी सीधे नापा ही नहीं गया।
scenes.image_brief: A single polished sentence printed large on cream paper, pinned to a corkboard beside an empty checklist with no ticks in any box, soft even light.

scenes.narration: So the tone stays smooth even where the content quietly goes wrong. Same voice throughout.
scenes.caption: इसलिए लहज़ा वैसा ही रहता है, चाहे अंदर की बात सही न हो।
scenes.image_brief: A long unbroken ribbon of printed text curling across a table like a till receipt, one section shaded slightly darker than the rest, low side light.

scenes.narration: A wrong sentence and a correct one arrive in identical packaging. Same rhythm. Same confidence.
scenes.caption: सही और ग़लत वाक्य एक ही पैकिंग में आते हैं। वही लय, वही भरोसा।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical sealed envelopes side by side on dark fabric, same size, same wax seal, no label on either, one set slightly ahead of the other, soft directional light.

scenes.narration: You cannot hear the difference. Nobody can. Listening is the wrong tool for this job.
scenes.caption: अंतर सुनकर पकड़ में नहीं आता। सुनना इसका सही रास्ता नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A pair of over-ear headphones resting on a printed transcript, the pages showing two paragraphs marked A and B with no other difference visible, dim warm light.

scenes.narration: And that costs real money. An invented citation can cost a student a whole assignment.
scenes.caption: इसका असर असली होता है। गढ़ा हुआ हवाला पूरा असाइनमेंट ले डूबता है।
scenes.image_brief: A returned essay page on a desk with the bibliography section underlined and a large red mark beside one entry, the rest of the page untouched, cold daylight.

scenes.narration: An invented number can cost a business one very awkward meeting. Or a contract.
scenes.caption: गढ़ा हुआ आंकड़ा किसी दफ़्तर की एक बैठक भारी कर देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A boardroom table seen from one end, a printed slide left face up with one highlighted figure, chairs pushed back at odd angles, harsh ceiling light.

scenes.narration: Most explanations stop at one warning. Always verify. True, but useless on its own.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादातर बातें एक चेतावनी पर रुक जाती हैं: जाँच लो। यह अधूरा है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed notice taped to a wall reading nothing but a short warning line, its lower half torn away and missing, scuffed paint around it, flat corridor light.

scenes.narration: Knowing where invention happens is far better. It happens in one specific kind of slot.
scenes.caption: बेहतर है जानना कि गढ़ंत कहाँ होती है। वह एक ख़ास जगह पर होती है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed form on a clipboard where every field is filled except one narrow blank box outlined in red, a pen lying across the clipboard, warm desk light.

scenes.narration: By the end, you will know exactly what the machine computes at each step.
scenes.caption: आख़िर तक आप जान जाएंगे कि मशीन हर चरण पर क्या हिसाब लगाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A cross-section diagram sketched in pencil on graph paper, an arrow entering a plain box and a column of scores leaving it, a ruler and eraser beside, cool light.

scenes.narration: You will know why one changed word can change an entire answer. Not soften it.
scenes.caption: आप समझेंगे कि एक शब्द बदलने से पूरा जवाब क्यों बदल जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two printed prompt lines stacked on white paper, identical except one word in the lower line boxed in ink, a wide empty space below both lines, soft light.

scenes.narration: You will know which slot in a sentence quietly invites invention. It is predictable.
scenes.caption: आप पहचानेंगे कि वाक्य की कौन सी जगह गढ़ंत को न्योता देती है।
scenes.image_brief: A sentence printed on a long strip of card with one word cut clean out, leaving a rectangular hole through which the dark table surface shows, angled light.

scenes.narration: And a sixty second check that catches most of the damage. That is the whole promise.
scenes.caption: और एक साठ सेकंड की जाँच, जो ज़्यादातर गड़बड़ पकड़ लेती है।
scenes.image_brief: A small kitchen timer set near one minute standing on a stack of two printed pages, a pencil resting alongside, plain tabletop, bright even light.

scenes.narration: One question runs underneath all of it. Why fluent and wrong at the same time?
scenes.caption: इसके नीचे एक सवाल है: बहाव और ग़लती साथ-साथ क्यों होती हैं?
scenes.image_brief: A single question mark pressed into thick cream paper as a deep blind emboss with no ink, lit from one low angle so only its shadow reveals the shape.

scenes.narration: Start with the text itself. A model never sees letters as letters. Not once.
scenes.caption: शुरुआत लिखाई से। मॉडल अक्षरों को अक्षर की तरह कभी नहीं देखता।
scenes.image_brief: Metal letterpress type pieces spilled across a workbench, each block turned face down so no letter is visible, only blank metal backs, hard workshop light.

scenes.narration: Text gets chopped into pieces called tokens. Some are whole common words, nothing stranger.
scenes.caption: लिखाई टुकड़ों में कटती है, जिन्हें टोकन कहते हैं। कुछ पूरे शब्द होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A paper sentence physically cut apart with scissors into uneven fragments laid out in order on a green cutting mat, the scissors open beside them, cool bright light.

scenes.narration: Others are fragments. Un. Break. Able. Sometimes a single space, or half a name.
scenes.caption: बाक़ी टुकड़े अधूरे होते हैं: अन, ब्रेक, एबल, या बस एक ख़ाली जगह।
scenes.image_brief: Three small paper fragments held apart on dark felt, each bearing part of one long word, a narrow gap between them, one blank fragment at the end, soft top light.

scenes.narration: Each token carries an id number. So your sentence becomes a plain list of numbers.
scenes.caption: हर टोकन का एक नंबर होता है। इसलिए वाक्य नंबरों की सूची बन जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A handwritten column of numbers on lined paper beside a torn strip of printed words, thin pencil lines pairing each word fragment to one number, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Numbers can be compared, measured and nudged. Letters cannot. That is the entire reason.
scenes.caption: नंबरों को नापा और बदला जा सकता है, अक्षरों को नहीं। बात यही है।
scenes.image_brief: A pair of brass weighing scales on a stone counter, small numbered brass discs in one pan and a crumpled paper word in the other, the pans hanging unevenly, warm light.

scenes.narration: Each id then maps to a long row of numbers. Treat it as coordinates.
scenes.caption: फिर हर नंबर एक लंबी नंबर-पंक्ति बनता है। उसे एक पता समझ लीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A folded paper map spread open on a table with a single pin pushed through one point, faint grid lines and no place names printed anywhere, low afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Picture a vast map where related meanings sit close together. Rivers near lakes. Grief near loss.
scenes.caption: एक बड़े नक़्शे जैसा, जहाँ मिलते-जुलते अर्थ पास-पास बैठते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A dense cluster of pins pushed into a large blank wall chart, tight groups in some regions and empty stretches between them, no string between pins, even gallery light.

scenes.narration: Nobody drew that map by hand. Training pushed every point into its position, slowly.
scenes.caption: यह नक़्शा किसी ने हाथ से नहीं बनाया। प्रशिक्षण ने हर बिंदु जमाया।
scenes.image_brief: A half-arranged wall chart of pins, several pins lying loose on the floor below it, faint old holes visible where pins were moved earlier, dim work light.

scenes.narration: Training is one exercise, repeated. Hide the next token. Guess it. Check it. Repeat.
scenes.caption: प्रशिक्षण एक ही कसरत है: अगला टोकन छिपाओ, अंदाज़ा लगाओ, जाँचो, दोहराओ।
scenes.image_brief: A flashcard face down on a desk beside an identical card standing upright with its blank back showing, a tally of pencil marks on scrap paper nearby, plain light.

scenes.narration: Compare each guess against the real token. Measure how wrong it was, as one number.
scenes.caption: हर अंदाज़े को असली टोकन से मिलाओ। ग़लती को एक नंबर में नापो।
scenes.image_brief: Two paper cards clipped side by side on a wire line, one showing a word and one showing a different word, a single digit chalked on the wall beneath them, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: Then nudge millions of internal numbers slightly toward a better guess. Slightly. Not dramatically.
scenes.caption: फिर लाखों भीतरी नंबरों को बेहतर अंदाज़े की तरफ़ ज़रा-सा खिसकाओ।
scenes.image_brief: A wall of small brass dials on a control panel, each one turned a fraction away from centre, fingerprints on the metal between them, warm low light from the side.

scenes.narration: Repeat across an enormous pile of written text. Billions of tiny corrections, one after another.
scenes.caption: लिखाई के बड़े ढेर पर यही अरबों बार दोहराओ, छोटे-छोटे सुधारों के साथ।
scenes.image_brief: A towering stack of loose printed pages rising above a desk edge, the top sheets faintly smudged from handling, a stub of pencil balanced on top, dim light.

scenes.narration: Because the only goal is the next token, everything it learns must serve that goal.
scenes.caption: मक़सद सिर्फ़ अगला टोकन है, तो जो भी सीखा जाता है उसी के लिए।
scenes.image_brief: A single narrow doorway at the end of a bare corridor, every object in the corridor angled toward it, the floor scuffed in one direction, hard light from the doorway.

scenes.narration: Grammar helps prediction. So grammar gets absorbed, without one rule ever being taught explicitly.
scenes.caption: व्याकरण अंदाज़े में मदद करता है, तो वह बिना सिखाए ही सीख लिया जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A closed grammar textbook lying under a thin film of dust on a shelf, its spine uncracked, a neatly written page beside it on the shelf edge, soft window light.

scenes.narration: Facts that appear together help prediction. So those pairings get absorbed too. Capital. City. Country.
scenes.caption: साथ आने वाले तथ्य भी मदद करते हैं, तो वे जोड़े भी सीख लिए जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two words printed on separate slips lying overlapped at one corner on dark wood, a faint ink line linking them, other slips scattered much further away, low light.

scenes.narration: Reasoning steps appear in written text. So the shape of reasoning gets absorbed as well.
scenes.caption: तर्क के चरण भी लिखाई में मिलते हैं, तो उनका ढाँचा भी सीख लिया जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A worked arithmetic proof handwritten down a long sheet of paper in numbered steps, the final line left blank, the sheet curling at the bottom, plain desk light.

scenes.narration: Now watch it run. Your prompt arrives as tokens, in order, all at once.
scenes.caption: अब चलता हुआ मॉडल देखिए। आपका सवाल टोकन बनकर एक साथ पहुँचता है।
scenes.image_brief: A row of numbered paper tiles lined up along a shallow wooden tray, their edges touching, the tray resting on a desk with a clean empty surface behind, even light.

scenes.narration: Each token looks back at the earlier tokens. It weights which ones actually matter here.
scenes.caption: हर टोकन पिछले टोकनों को देखता है और तय करता है कौन ज़्यादा मायने रखता है।
scenes.image_brief: A row of wooden tiles with fine threads running backward from the last tile to several earlier ones, the threads varying in thickness, dark table, low side light.

scenes.narration: That weighting is attention. It is how surrounding context steers the very next guess.
scenes.caption: इस तोल को अटेंशन कहते हैं। संदर्भ इसी से अगला अंदाज़ा मोड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A ship's wheel mounted on a plain post, held in position mid-turn by two tensioned ropes pulling from opposite sides, salt-worn wood, overcast light.

scenes.narration: The model finishes with a score for every token in its vocabulary. Every single one.
scenes.caption: आख़िर में मॉडल अपनी पूरी शब्द-सूची के हर टोकन को एक अंक देता है।
scenes.image_brief: An enormous printed ledger opened flat across two desks, every line carrying a short fragment and a number, the columns running off the visible edge, cool light.

scenes.narration: Scores become probabilities. One token is picked. It joins the sentence and stays there.
scenes.caption: अंक संभावना बनते हैं। एक टोकन चुना जाता है और वाक्य में जुड़ जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single paper tile lifted out of a crowded tray and set at the end of an existing row of tiles, the gap it left visible behind it, warm directional light.

scenes.narration: Then the whole computation runs again, with that new token now part of the input.
scenes.caption: फिर पूरा हिसाब दोबारा चलता है, नए टोकन को भी इनपुट में लेकर।
scenes.image_brief: A hand-cranked mill wheel at rest on a stone base, grain heaped in the feed chute with one extra kernel sitting on top, flour dust in the air, low light.

scenes.narration: So an answer is a chain of local guesses. Nothing ever checks the whole thing.
scenes.caption: यानी जवाब स्थानीय अंदाज़ों की एक कड़ी है। पूरे को कोई नहीं जाँचता।
scenes.image_brief: A long metal chain laid in a winding line across a concrete floor, every link sound, no inspection tag anywhere along its length, harsh overhead industrial light.

scenes.narration: Numbers make this concrete. The figures here are illustrative, chosen because they are easy to follow.
scenes.caption: अब उदाहरण। यहाँ के आंकड़े समझाने के लिए हैं, असली नाप नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A clean sheet of graph paper on a desk with a mechanical pencil and a plain calculator set beside it, nothing written on the page yet, bright neutral daylight.

scenes.narration: Take a vocabulary of fifty thousand tokens. That is roughly typical in scale, not exact.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए पचास हज़ार टोकन की शब्द-सूची। यह मोटा अंदाज़ा है।
scenes.image_brief: A wall of card catalogue drawers filling the frame, dozens of small labelled drawers, one drawer slightly ajar showing tightly packed cards, dim archive light.

scenes.narration: Now the prompt. My phone battery drains fastest when the screen is... and it stops there.
scenes.caption: सवाल: मेरे फ़ोन की बैटरी सबसे तेज़ तब घटती है जब स्क्रीन...
scenes.image_brief: A printed line of text ending mid-sentence on white paper, the remaining half of the line left empty, a phone lying face down beside it, soft morning light.

scenes.narration: The model scores all fifty thousand options for that one empty slot. All of them.
scenes.caption: मॉडल उस एक ख़ाली जगह के लिए पूरे पचास हज़ार विकल्पों को अंक देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A vast scoreboard of narrow slots covering a wall, each slot holding a small numbered card, one slot near the centre lit brighter than the rest, cool hall light.

scenes.narration: Say bright lands at forty one percent. On at twenty two. Dim at nine.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए: ब्राइट 41 प्रतिशत, ऑन 22 प्रतिशत, डिम 9 प्रतिशत।
scenes.image_brief: Three horizontal bars drawn in chalk on a slate board, clearly different lengths, a short word written at the start of each bar, warm lamp light from above.

scenes.narration: The rest split what remains. Mostly fractions of one percent. Thousands of near-zero candidates.
scenes.caption: बाक़ी विकल्प बची हुई जगह बाँटते हैं, वह भी एक प्रतिशत से कम।
scenes.image_brief: A dense field of extremely short chalk tick marks along the bottom edge of a slate board, so faint they nearly vanish, one bold bar far above them, side light.

scenes.narration: Pick bright. Append it. Now the entire computation restarts with bright already inside the sentence.
scenes.caption: ब्राइट चुनो, जोड़ो। अब पूरा हिसाब उसी शब्द के साथ फिर से शुरू।
scenes.image_brief: A printed sentence now complete, its final word set in slightly darker ink, a fresh empty box ruled after it, pencil shavings scattered nearby, plain light.

scenes.narration: Notice what actually happened. The surrounding sentence constrained that answer almost completely, on its own.
scenes.caption: ध्यान दीजिए: आसपास के शब्दों ने ही जवाब को लगभग तय कर दिया।
scenes.image_brief: A narrow paper funnel standing upright on a table, its mouth wide at the top, a single small bead resting at the narrow base, soft light from one side.

scenes.narration: Grammar allowed an adjective there. The topic allowed only a handful of sensible adjectives.
scenes.caption: व्याकरण ने विशेषण की जगह दी, और विषय ने गिने-चुने विशेषण छोड़े।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden shape-sorter board with one triangular hole and only three matching triangular blocks left beside it, other blocks pushed far aside, warm nursery light.

scenes.narration: Now change one word. My phone battery drains fastest when the temperature is... and stop.
scenes.caption: अब एक शब्द बदलिए: ...जब तापमान... और वहीं रुक जाइए।
scenes.image_brief: The same printed prompt line with one word covered by a pasted paper patch carrying a different word, the patch edge visible, the line ending mid-air, desk light.

scenes.narration: The shortlist changes completely. High. Low. Above. Below. Bright has fallen off it entirely.
scenes.caption: सूची पूरी तरह बदल जाती है: हाई, लो, ऊपर, नीचे। ब्राइट बाहर।
scenes.image_brief: A slate board wiped half clean, four new short words written in a fresh column with new bars, a smudged ghost of the old column still faintly visible, low light.

scenes.narration: Nothing was looked up in either case. The surrounding words did all the steering.
scenes.caption: दोनों बार कुछ भी खोजा नहीं गया। आसपास के शब्दों ने ही दिशा दी।
scenes.image_brief: A closed reference book pressed shut with a rubber band on a shelf, thick dust along its top edge, a bare reading table in front of it, faint window light.

scenes.narration: That is your lever, and the most useful thing here. Hold onto it until the end.
scenes.caption: यही आपका असली ज़ोर है। इसे आख़िर तक याद रखिए।
scenes.image_brief: A long steel lever resting in a slotted floor bracket, its handle polished bright from use, the surrounding concrete floor plain and empty, hard side light.

scenes.narration: Now the dangerous version. Ask that phone battery's exact capacity, in a single sentence.
scenes.caption: अब ख़तरनाक हाल: उसी बैटरी की ठीक-ठीक क्षमता पूछ लीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on its back on a workbench beside a small blank specification label and a pair of tweezers, no printing on the label at all, cool bench light.

scenes.narration: The pattern demands a number in that slot. Something has to go there. Blank is impossible.
scenes.caption: ढाँचा उस जगह एक आंकड़ा माँगता है। ख़ाली छोड़ना मुमकिन नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A printed certificate with every line completed except one numeric field, that field showing a bold empty ruled box, an ink pad waiting beside it, plain light.

scenes.narration: So it produces one. Four thousand five hundred milliamp hours. Round, plausible, immediately convincing.
scenes.caption: तो वह एक आंकड़ा गढ़ देता है: 4500 एमएएच। सुनने में पूरा सही।
scenes.image_brief: A crisp printed number on a small white card propped against a matte black block, the card edges sharp, no logo or source printed anywhere, soft studio light.

scenes.narration: That figure is invented for this example. A model can invent one exactly the same way.
scenes.caption: यह आंकड़ा उदाहरण के लिए गढ़ा गया है। मॉडल भी ऐसे ही गढ़ सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical white cards side by side on dark cloth, each showing a different four digit number, neither card carrying a source line, even overhead light.

scenes.narration: It feels right because similar sentences carry similar numbers. That resemblance is the whole basis.
scenes.caption: सही लगता है क्योंकि ऐसे वाक्यों में ऐसे ही आंकड़े आते हैं। बस इतना।
scenes.image_brief: Several printed product labels pinned in a row on a corkboard, each showing a different but similar four digit rating, one blank label at the end, flat light.

scenes.narration: Now count the steps. A three hundred word answer is roughly four hundred tokens.
scenes.caption: अब चरण गिनिए: तीन सौ शब्दों का जवाब लगभग चार सौ टोकन होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed page of continuous prose lying flat, its right margin filled with small pencil tally marks in dense clusters, a worn pencil across the corner, desk light.

scenes.narration: Four hundred separate choices, each from fifty thousand candidates. And no review pass afterwards.
scenes.caption: चार सौ अलग चुनाव, हर बार पचास हज़ार में से। और दोबारा जाँच नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A long assembly bench with hundreds of identical small parts set in neat rows, the inspection station at the far end of the bench standing empty, cold factory light.

scenes.narration: Most of those choices were nearly forced. A few were wide open. Those few carry the risk.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादातर चुनाव लगभग तय थे। कुछ खुले थे, और ख़तरा उन्हीं में है।
scenes.image_brief: A row of narrow doorways along a corridor, nearly all of them wedged almost shut, two standing wide open with light spilling out, bare floor, low light.

scenes.narration: Now the limits, starting with a mistake I nearly walked you into. Watch the arithmetic.
scenes.caption: अब सीमाएँ, और पहले वह भूल जो मैं लगभग करा ही चुका था।
scenes.image_brief: A pencil calculation on a notepad with one line struck through twice, the eraser end of the pencil worn flat and resting on the page, warm desk light.

scenes.narration: Four hundred steps, each ninety five percent reliable. That sounds survivable. Run the multiplication.
scenes.caption: चार सौ चरण, हर एक 95 प्रतिशत भरोसेमंद। गुणा करके देखिए।
scenes.image_brief: A slip of paper showing a repeated multiplication written out by hand and trailing off into dots, held under a magnet on a metal cabinet door, cool light.

scenes.narration: Multiply it out and you get almost nothing. Roughly one chance in a billion.
scenes.caption: गुणा करने पर नतीजा लगभग शून्य आता है, अरब में एक जैसा।
scenes.image_brief: A single grain of rice placed alone at the centre of a wide empty dark tray, the tray rim catching a thin line of light, everything else bare.

scenes.narration: Yet real answers arrive coherent, paragraph after paragraph. So that multiplication model is simply wrong.
scenes.caption: फिर भी जवाब जुड़े हुए आते हैं। यानी वह गुणा वाला हिसाब ग़लत है।
scenes.image_brief: A finished page of neatly justified prose held flat under a glass paperweight, its edges perfectly aligned, no marks or corrections anywhere, clear daylight.

scenes.narration: Most steps are almost forced by grammar. And errors are not independent of each other.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादातर चरण व्याकरण से तय होते हैं, और ग़लतियाँ आज़ाद नहीं होतीं।
scenes.image_brief: A line of dominoes standing in a groove cut into a wooden plank, unable to fall sideways, one domino tilted against the groove wall, warm raking light.

scenes.narration: Second mistake. Believing it looked something up. It did not look anything up. Nowhere.
scenes.caption: दूसरी भूल: यह मानना कि उसने कहीं खोजकर बताया। खोजा कुछ नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A library reading desk with its lamp switched off, a closed catalogue volume, and a request slip left blank on the blotter, chair pushed in, dim evening light.

scenes.narration: Unless a search tool is attached, there is no source and no citation available.
scenes.caption: जब तक खोज का औज़ार न जुड़ा हो, कोई स्रोत और हवाला नहीं होता।
scenes.image_brief: The empty footnote area at the foot of a printed page, a ruled line drawn but nothing written below it, the page corner slightly lifted, soft lamplight.

scenes.narration: The opposite mistake is just as common. Just predicting text sounds like a dismissal.
scenes.caption: उलटी भूल भी आम है: कहना कि यह तो बस अगला शब्द बताता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small clockwork mechanism laid open on a velvet cloth, dozens of tiny gears meshed in layers, a curt handwritten tag resting beside it, focused bench light.

scenes.narration: Prediction at that scale forces real structure to appear. Dismissing it explains nothing at all.
scenes.caption: इतने पैमाने पर अंदाज़ा असली ढाँचा बनाता है। टाल देना कुछ नहीं समझाता।
scenes.image_brief: A section of honeycomb held upright against a plain background, its cells uniformly hexagonal with no template or mould nearby, warm light through the wax.

scenes.narration: Third mistake. Hearing confidence as probability. I am certain is itself predicted text. Nothing more.
scenes.caption: तीसरी भूल: भरोसे को संभावना मान लेना। वह भी गढ़ा हुआ वाक्य है।
scenes.image_brief: A bold printed phrase on a card standing in a small brass holder, the card face clean, an empty measuring gauge lying flat beside it, cool even light.

scenes.narration: Those words were simply likely there. They are not a measurement of anything real.
scenes.caption: वे शब्द वहाँ सिर्फ़ मुमकिन थे। वे किसी सच की नाप नहीं हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A thermometer with no scale markings mounted on a plain wall, the liquid column clearly risen but unreadable, a shadow falling across the tube, side light.

scenes.narration: And AI is not one single thing. Image tools predict pixels, not text tokens.
scenes.caption: और एआई एक चीज़ नहीं है। इमेज वाले औज़ार पिक्सल का अंदाज़ा लगाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A printed photograph enlarged until individual square pixels are visible, taped to a wall beside an unrelated sheet of plain text, flat gallery light.

scenes.narration: Spam filters and recommenders work differently again. This chain describes language models only. Nothing else.
scenes.caption: स्पैम फ़िल्टर और सुझाव देने वाले अलग ढंग से चलते हैं। यह बात भाषा मॉडल की है।
scenes.image_brief: Three separate labelled machines on a workshop shelf, each a different shape and size, no wires running between any of them, dusty concrete wall, low light.

scenes.narration: Return to the opening line. One guess, repeated, with no plan sitting behind it.
scenes.caption: शुरुआती बात पर लौटिए: एक अंदाज़ा, बार-बार, बिना किसी योजना के।
scenes.image_brief: The first printed sheet from earlier, its word-shaped blank now filled in pencil, the sheet lying on top of a thick finished stack of pages, warm lamplight.

scenes.narration: That sounded like nothing but a weakness. Half of it is actually your leverage.
scenes.caption: यह कमज़ोरी जैसा लगा था। आधा हिस्सा असल में आपकी ताक़त है।
scenes.image_brief: A bent iron bar used as a lever under the edge of a heavy stone slab, a small wooden block serving as the fulcrum, gravel underfoot, hard afternoon light.

scenes.narration: You cannot change what the model absorbed during training. That part is completely fixed.
scenes.caption: प्रशिक्षण में जो सीखा गया, उसे आप बदल नहीं सकते। वह तय है।
scenes.image_brief: A cast concrete block set into a floor with a maker's mark pressed into it while wet, the surface now fully cured and hard, cool overcast light.

scenes.narration: But every word you supply reshapes the shortlist, at every single step. Every one.
scenes.caption: लेकिन आपके दिए हर शब्द से हर चरण की सूची बदल जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A set of railway points beside a track, the switch blade thrown to one side, two rails diverging into the distance, gravel ballast, low sun along the rails.

scenes.narration: Vague prompt, wide shortlist, invented specifics. Precise prompt, narrow shortlist, far less invention. Same model.
scenes.caption: अधूरा सवाल: चौड़ी सूची और गढ़ंत। साफ़ सवाल: छोटी सूची, कम गढ़ंत।
scenes.image_brief: Two paper funnels standing side by side on a bench, one with a wide mouth and one narrow, a scatter of loose beads around the wide one only, even bench light.

scenes.narration: Paste the real document in. Then the constrained slots no longer need inventing at all.
scenes.caption: असली दस्तावेज़ साथ दीजिए। तब तय जगहों को कुछ गढ़ना नहीं पड़ता।
scenes.image_brief: A printed source document laid directly beneath a half-finished summary sheet on a desk, matching figures visible on both pages, clean daylight from the left.

scenes.narration: And the confidence you hear finally has a source. It is sentence fit, nothing else.
scenes.caption: जो भरोसा सुनाई देता है उसका स्रोत साफ़ है: वाक्य का बैठ जाना।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden joint fitted perfectly together on a workbench, no gap along the seam, a capped glue bottle beside it, sawdust swept into a small pile, warm light.

scenes.narration: It is the sound of words that follow each other well. Nothing deeper than that.
scenes.caption: यह उन शब्दों की आवाज़ है जो एक-दूसरे के बाद ठीक बैठते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A tuning fork resting on a polished stone slab beside a closed unlabelled instrument case, the fork completely still, soft reflected light across the stone.

scenes.narration: So trust the shape of an answer more than its specifics. That ordering matters.
scenes.caption: जवाब के ढाँचे पर ज़्यादा भरोसा कीजिए, ब्यौरों पर कम। क्रम यही है।
scenes.image_brief: A pencil outline of a building on tracing paper laid over a detailed plan, the outline crisp while the fine dimensions beneath show through softened, soft light.

scenes.narration: Structure comes from patterns seen everywhere. A specific number comes from one open slot.
scenes.caption: ढाँचा हर जगह दिखे नमूनों से आता है। कोई एक आंकड़ा एक खुली जगह से।
scenes.image_brief: A woven basket standing upright on a table with one broken reed sticking out of an otherwise tight weave, the flaw clearly local, warm directional light.

scenes.narration: One action, right now. Open the last AI answer you actually relied on for something.
scenes.caption: एक काम अभी: वह पिछला एआई जवाब खोलिए जिस पर आपने भरोसा किया था।
scenes.image_brief: A phone propped against a mug on a table showing a long scrolled block of grey text, a paper notepad open beside it with one ruled line marked, morning light.

scenes.narration: Find every number and name inside it. Check only those. Sixty seconds, well spent.
scenes.caption: उसमें हर आंकड़ा और नाम ढूँढिए। सिर्फ़ उन्हें जाँचिए। साठ सेकंड।
scenes.image_brief: A printed page with three items circled in pencil, two numbers and one proper name, the rest of the page untouched, a small clock face at the edge, clear light.
